Sparta Coop Services
                               Spray Policy
1. Sparta Coop Services does not guarantee performance on any of the chemicals
we custom apply.

    A. All chemicals have limited warranties which are written on the labels and
serviced by the company producing the product.
    B. You should scout your fields every 5 to 7 days.
    C. If a problem does develop, you must contact Sparta Coop Services within 21
days following the application in question.
    D. A representative of Sparta Coop Services will come out and assess the situation
and, if necessary, contact the chemical sales representative.
    E. Sparta Coop Services will work with you and the chemical sales representative in
order to arrive at a satisfactory solution.

2. Mechanical Controls

    A. Use of a rotary hoe is recommended if the first flush of weeds is not controlled
by the chemicals or if no rainfall has occurred to activate the spray solution.
    B. Cultivation not only enhances rainfall infiltration, but also enhances weed
control.

3.   Set Realistic Control Standards

      A. There is no such thing as 100% control. Be prepared to settle for less. One
foxtail plant can produce up to 50 plants per square foot. 90% control will mean you
still hae 5 plants per square foot remaining. This weed population will not affect your
yield.
